labels.running:
Induction after fentanyl and midazolam
Choose another scenario
The same fit 40-year-old man as the healthy induction, preoxygenated in the same way (the oxygen stays on until you press “Induce now” at 3:00), given fentanyl 2 µg/kg and midazolam 0.03 mg/kg at 0:10, about three minutes before the same propofol and rocuronium. Breathing slows before induction, the apnoea comes earlier and the pressure falls further: in the healthy induction the mean pressure fell from 95 to 65 mmHg with the heart rate 70–79; here it falls from 90 to 52 with the heart rate 55–62.
